name: How long does a typical room addition project take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical room addition project take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a room addition project varies based on its size, complexity, and local permitting processes. Generally, a small single-story addition might take 3-6 months, while larger or second-story additions could extend to 6-12 months or more. This timeline includes design, permitting, construction, and final inspections. We work to provide a clear timeline estimate after the initial design phase, factoring in all necessary steps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary, but a typical room addition can take 3-12 months, depending on size, complexity, and permitting.
